CustomField.inlineHelpText: The method used for identifying what checkpoint steps and communications need to be completed for Cases on this Account. - Standard: All steps and communications are followed. - No Communication: All steps followed but no communication is sent to the client. - No Solution Delivered: Deployment Approval and Solution Delivered communication skipped. Everything else is standard. - Case Data Only: Does both No Communication and No Solution Delivered.
CustomField.label: MS Checkpoint Communication
